import os
import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

def organize_media(source_dir, archive_base):
    source_path = Path(source_dir)
    archive_path = Path(archive_base)
    
    # Medya uzantıları
    media_extensions = {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.mp4', '.mov'}
    # Tarih kalıpları: YYYYMMDD veya YYYY-MM-DD (20 ile başlayan)
    date_pattern = re.compile(r'(20\d{6}|20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})')

    if not source_path.exists():
        print(f"Hata: {source_dir} dizini bulunamadı.")
        return

    results = {
        "moved": 0,
        "tarihsiz": 0,
        "skipped": 0
    }

    # Recursive tarama
    for file_path in source_path.rglob('*'):
        if file_path.is_dir():
            continue
            
        # Sadece medya dosyaları
        if file_path.suffix.lower() not in media_extensions:
            results["skipped"] += 1
            continue

        file_name = file_path.name
        match = date_pattern.search(file_name)
        
        target_subdir = None

        if match:
            date_str = match.group(1)
            if '-' in date_str:
                # YYYY-MM-DD formatı
                parts = date_str.split('-')
                year = parts[0]
                month = parts[1]
            else:
                # YYYYMMDD formatı
                year = date_str[:4]
                month = date_str[4:6]
            
            target_subdir = archive_path / year / month
        else:
            target_subdir = archive_path / "tarihsiz"

        # Hedef klasörü oluştur ve dosyayı taşı
        target_subdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Çakışma kontrolü (aynı isimli dosya varsa ismin sonuna sayı ekle)
        destination = target_subdir / file_path.name
        counter = 1
        while destination.exists():
            destination = target_subdir / f"{file_path.stem}_{counter}{file_path.suffix}"
            counter += 1

        shutil.move(str(file_path), str(destination))
        
        if target_subdir.name == "tarihsiz":
            results["tarihsiz"] += 1
        else:
            results["moved"] += 1

    print(f"İşlem Tamamlandı!")
    print(f"Taşınan (Tarihli): {results['moved']}")
    print(f"Taşınan (Tarihsiz): {results['tarihsiz']}")
    print(f"Atlanan (Medya olmayan): {results['skipped']}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    organize_media("gelen", "arsiv")

import re

def test_date_extraction():
    date_pattern = re.compile(r'(20\d{6}|20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})')
    test_cases = [
        ("IMG_20240312_101500.jpg", "2024", "03"),
        ("Screenshot_2024-01-05-10-00-00.png", "2024", "01"),
        ("PXL_20250701_093000123.jpg", "2025", "07"),
        ("VID_20231225_200000.mp4", "2023", "12"),
        ("IMG_hatali.jpg", None, None),
        ("2022-12-31_test.png", "2022", "12")
    ]

    for filename, year, month in test_cases:
        match = date_pattern.search(filename)
        actual_year, actual_month = None, None
        if match:
            date_str = match.group(1)
            if '-' in date_str:
                parts = date_str.split('-')
                actual_year, actual_month = parts[0], parts[1]
            else:
                actual_year, actual_month = date_str[:4], date_str[4:6]
        
        status = "PASSED" if (year == actual_year and month == actual_month) else "FAILED"
        print(f"File: {filename} -> Expected: {year}-{month}, Actual: {actual_year}-{actual_month} | {status}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_date_extraction()
